newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade virtual yen options from February 24.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade virtual yen options from February 24.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it would begin trading dollar-denominated delivery (3-D) Japanese yen options on February 24.
The exchange said the contracts, known as virtual currency options, would have expirations ranging from one week to nine months and would be cash-settled in U.S. dollars.
Tague Securities would be the specialist for the 3-D yen options, the second virtual currency option the PHLX has launched.
3-D Deutsche mark options were launched in September 1994. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
